_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/gl.jsx GLJournalVoucher (L17-98) + JVCreateForm (L111-213). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai/baht never appear in .tsx source. crumbSection/crumbScreen render the breadcrumb. Each value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, em-dash U+2014, baht U+0E3F, check U+2713, warn U+26A0, not-equal U+2260). Values present in i18n-full.json.phrases resolve via tp(); values in _missing are NOT yet in i18n-full.json — they render honest Thai (th) / key-fallback (en/zh/ar) and are flagged for the Wave-2 i18n round (P2-WEB-13). all/status/export/cancel reuse existing DICT keys (common.all / common.status / vendor.btnExport / common.cancel) via t(), not this file. gl.jv is a NEW screen so most compound strings are still absent.
